QS1.why: [E] ≥ start-up 0.10 s + 2 × loop delay: the open-loop body stays inside the standing envelope long enough for a delayed loop to act

QS2.why: [E] λ·τ ≤ 1 (margin √2 on the delayed-PD stabilisability limit λτ < √2, Stépán): the departure must be catchable by a 175 ms loop

QS3.why: [M] passive + fixed tone cannot stand (every primary source): the body must leave the envelope; 4 s = 1.5 × the slowest human-equivalent estimate

criteria.I1a: ankle K/mgh at the end of the 41.7 ms ramp within [0.5, 1.5] × Vlutters 2015 at the measured angle, all 5 amplitudes
criteria.I1b: ankle K/mgh at 71 ms within [0.5, 1.5] × Sakanaka 2021 at the measured angle, every amplitude with angle ≤ 1.0°
criteria.I2: knee elastic stiffness at 100 ms ≥ 17 N·m/rad (small amplitude, both signs)
criteria.I3: hip elastic stiffness at 100 ms within [30, 91] N·m/rad (small amplitude, both signs)

S1.why: [D] not a floppy ragdoll: no collapse (relative pelvis drop ≤ 5 mm) and bounded sway (relative COM displacement at 300 ms ≤ ½ the COM-to-edge margin)

S2.why: [D] not a rigid mannequin: a measurable joint deflection somewhere between pelvis and ground

S3.why: [D] the joint-level transient decays: RMS relative joint speed 200–300 ms ≤ that at 50–150 ms

criteria.S4: no loss of no-step balance within 300 ms (XcoM inside the base of support, both feet loaded)

M1.why: [D] substantial sway / yield: larger than small (×1.3 for ×1.6 impulse) and ≥ 1° or ≥ 15 mm COM

criteria.M2: no loss of no-step balance within 300 ms
criteria.L1: loss of no-step balance within 300 ms
criteria.C1: per direction: COM displacement at 300 ms and max joint deflection strictly increase small < moderate < large
criteria.R1: no growing oscillation after release (successive alternating extrema about the final value ≤ 1.05 × the previous)

R2.why: [D] not undamped where an oscillation (≥ 2 alternating extrema) is measurable

E1.why: [S] energy ledger closes where the feet stay planted: |Σ residual| ≤ 1 J + 5 % of |external work| (T1 from t0 to exit; small and moderate T2 to 300 ms). The ledger has no turf-contact term, so foot impacts and sliding (start-up, large pushes) appear as residual: reported, not judged

INT2.why: [S] V2 G1 spec 1.3c (at t0 in T1 and at 300 ms after small pushes)

criteria.DET: bit-identical reruns (standing 240 steps, moderate forward push)
